sections.number_formatting_description: How numbers are displayed across the system — decimal and thousands separators, digit grouping.
sections.precision_description: Number of decimal places used for different types of values throughout the system.
sections.currency_display_description: How monetary values are formatted — symbol placement, spacing, and negative number style.
sections.rounding_description: Rounding rules for calculations and cash transactions.
sections.date_time_description: Date format, time format, calendar system, and week start day used across the system.
sections.measurement_description: Default units of measure pre-selected when creating new items and materials.
sections.fiscal_description: Fiscal year configuration, inventory costing method, and tax behavior.
sections.document_defaults_description: Language, paper size, and text direction for generated documents and reports.

descriptions.decimal_separator: Character between the integer and fractional part. E.g., 1234.56 (dot) or 1234,56 (comma).
descriptions.thousands_separator: Character that groups digits for readability. E.g., 1,234 (comma) or 1.234 (dot).
descriptions.digit_grouping: How digits are grouped. Standard: 1,234,567. Indian: 12,34,567 (lakhs and crores).
descriptions.quantity_precision: Number of decimal places for item quantities (e.g., 2.5 kg or 2.5000 kg).
descriptions.price_precision: Number of decimal places for unit prices on orders and invoices.
descriptions.currency_precision: Number of decimal places for monetary totals. JPY uses 0, KWD uses 3.
descriptions.exchange_rate_precision: Number of decimal places for currency exchange rates. Higher = more accurate conversions.
descriptions.percentage_precision: Number of decimal places for percentages like tax rates and discounts.
descriptions.weight_precision: Number of decimal places for weight values in inventory and production.
descriptions.currency_symbol_position: Where the currency symbol appears relative to the amount. E.g., $100 (before) or 100€ (after).
descriptions.currency_spacing: Add a space between the currency symbol and the amount. E.g., $ 100 or 100 € instead of $100 or 100€.
descriptions.negative_format: How negative numbers are displayed. Accounting format uses parentheses: (100) instead of -100.
descriptions.rounding_method: How calculated values are rounded. Banker's rounding (half even) reduces cumulative rounding bias.
descriptions.cash_rounding_enabled: Round cash payment totals to the nearest physical denomination. E.g., Switzerland rounds to 0.05 CHF.
descriptions.cash_rounding_increment: The smallest cash denomination to round to. E.g., 0.05 (nickels), 0.10 (dimes), or 1.00 (whole units).
descriptions.date_format: How dates are displayed everywhere in the system. Does not affect how dates are stored internally.
descriptions.time_format: 12-hour format shows AM/PM (2:30 PM). 24-hour format uses military time (14:30).
descriptions.week_start_day: First day of the week in calendars and weekly reports. Varies by region.
descriptions.calendar_system: Calendar used for date display. Internal storage always uses Gregorian. Hijri is common in Saudi Arabia.
descriptions.measurement_system: Default unit system for the organization. Individual fields can still use any unit.
descriptions.default_weight_uom: Default weight unit pre-selected when creating new items or materials.
descriptions.default_length_uom: Default length unit pre-selected for dimensions on new items.
descriptions.default_volume_uom: Default volume unit pre-selected for liquid or bulk materials.
descriptions.default_temperature_uom: Default temperature unit for cold chain, food safety, and environmental monitoring.
descriptions.default_area_uom: Default area unit for warehouse floor space and production zones.
descriptions.fiscal_year_start_month: Month when your fiscal year begins. E.g., April for UK/India, July for Australia.
descriptions.fiscal_year_start_day: Day of the month when your fiscal year begins. E.g., UK starts April 6.
descriptions.fiscal_calendar_type: Standard uses calendar months. Retail calendars (4-4-5, 4-5-4, 5-4-4) use fixed week periods for consistent comparisons.
descriptions.cost_method: How inventory costs are calculated. Average: weighted mean. Standard: predetermined cost. FIFO: oldest stock first.
descriptions.tax_inclusive_pricing: When enabled, prices entered in the system already include tax. Common in EU, Australia, and New Zealand.
descriptions.default_document_language: Language used for generated PDFs, invoices, and reports. Enter a locale code (e.g., en, de, fr).
descriptions.default_paper_size: Paper size for generated PDFs. A4 is standard worldwide. Letter is used in the US and Canada.
descriptions.text_direction: Text direction for generated documents. RTL is used for Arabic, Hebrew, Farsi, and Urdu.

errors.separator_conflict: Decimal separator and thousands separator cannot use the same character.
errors.digit_grouping_requires_separator: Digit grouping requires a thousands separator.
errors.fiscal_day_exceeds_month: This day does not exist in the selected month.
